// ============================================================
// 3. DyePlants（cs:20126）
// ============================================================

/** ±num 方框内是否已有染料植物（cs:71316-71325，上界排他）。
 *  生成期只种非奇异株（frameX<272），而生成不会产出奇异株 → 等价于"任意 227" */
function dyeNearby(st: TileStore, i: number, j: number, rad: number): boolean {
  const w = st.w, h = st.h;
  const x0 = Math.max(1, Math.min(w - 2, i - rad));
  const x1 = Math.max(1, Math.min(w - 2, i + rad));
  const y0 = Math.max(1, Math.min(h - 2, j - rad));
  const y1 = Math.max(1, Math.min(h - 2, j + rad));
  for (let k = x0; k < x1; k++) {
    for (let l = y0; l < y1; l++) {
      const k2 = st.idx(k, l);
      if (st.flags[k2] && SHEET[st.type[k2]] === 227 && st.frameX[k2] < 272) return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

/** PlaceDye（cs:54004）1:1：style 门（上方豁免族/下方支撑/液体/墙） */
function placeDye(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, style: number): boolean {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y + 1) || !st.inBounds(x, y - 1)) return false;
  let ok = false;
  const i0 = st.idx(x, y);
  if (style === 7) {
    // 垂吊株：钉在天花板下
    if (activeAt(st, x, y + 1) && !DYE_PLANT_SIDE.has(sheetAt(st, x, y + 1))) return false;
    if (solidTile(st, x, y - 1) && !activeAt(st, x, y + 1)) ok = true;
  } else {
    if (activeAt(st, x, y - 1) && !DYE_PLANT_SIDE.has(sheetAt(st, x, y - 1))) return false;
    if (style === 6) {
      // 冰刺株（style 6）：须长在仙人掌 80 顶上且两侧空（nactive = active）
      if (activeAt(st, x, y + 1) && sheetAt(st, x, y + 1) === 80
        && !activeAt(st, x - 1, y + 1) && !activeAt(st, x + 1, y + 1)) ok = true;
    } else if (solidTile(st, x, y + 1) && !activeAt(st, x, y - 1)) {
      const liq = st.liquid[i0];
      const lt = st.liquidType[i0];
      if (style === 5) {
        // 水中株：满水且非岩浆/蜂蜜/微光
        if (liq === 255 && lt !== 2 && lt !== 3 && lt !== 4) ok = true;
      } else if (style >= 8 && style <= 11) {
        ok = true;                                                      // 奇异株（生成期不走）
      } else {
        if (liq !== 0) ok = false;
        else if (style === 3 || style === 4) {
          if (st.wall[i0] === 0) ok = true;                             // 地表株须无墙
        } else ok = true;
      }
    }
  }
  if (ok) {
    st.setTileSilent(x, y, DYE_PLANT, 34 * style, 0);                  // frameX = 34*style（cs:54078）
    st.half[i0] = 0;
    st.slope[i0] = 0;
  }
  return ok;
}

/** plantDye（cs:71298）1:1：表层/地下/垂吊三段（exoticPlant=false 生成路径） */
function plantDye(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, i: number, j: number): void {
  const w = st.w, h = st.h;
  if (!activeAt(st, i, j) || i < 95 || i > w - 95 || j < 95 || j > h - 95) return;
  const rad = 90;
  const aboveFree = !activeAt(st, i, j - 1) || DYE_PLANT_ABOVE.has(sheetAt(st, i, j - 1));
  // ---- 表层段（cs:71310-71389）----
  if (j < gs.worldSurface && aboveFree) {
    if (dyeNearby(st, i, j, rad)) return;
    const t = sheetAt(st, i, j);
    if (t === 2 || t === 109) {
      placeDye(st, i, j - 1, rng.int(0, 3) === 0 ? 4 : 3);              // Next(4)==0 → 4
    } else if (t === 60) {
      placeDye(st, i, j - 1, rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? 2 : 4);              // Next(2)
    } else if (t === 53 && st.inBounds(i, j - 2)
      && st.liquid[st.idx(i, j - 1)] === 255 && st.liquid[st.idx(i, j - 2)] === 255) {
      placeDye(st, i, j - 1, 2);                                        // 水下沙滩株
    } else if (t === 80 && !activeAt(st, i - 1, j - 1) && !activeAt(st, i + 1, j - 1)) {
      // 仙人掌顶（cs:71365-71388）：±5×(j-5..j+15) 内无黑檀/猩红沙 112/234
      let clear = true;
      for (let m = i - 5; m <= i + 5 && clear; m++) {
        for (let n = j - 5; n <= j + 15 && clear; n++) {
          if (!st.inBounds(m, n)) { clear = false; break; }
          const s = sheetAt(st, m, n);
          if (st.flags[st.idx(m, n)] && (s === 112 || s === 234)) clear = false;
        }
      }
      if (clear) placeDye(st, i, j - 1, 6);
    }
  }
  // ---- 段位门（cs:71390）：表层或地狱层直接返回 ----
  if (j < gs.worldSurface || j >= h - 200) return;                      // UnderworldLayer = h-200
  // ---- 地下段（cs:71394-71447）----
  if (aboveFree) {
    if (dyeNearby(st, i, j, rad)) return;
    const t = sheetAt(st, i, j);
    if (t === 60) {
      if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) placeDye(st, i, j - 1, 2);
      else if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) placeDye(st, i, j - 1, 0);
      else placeDye(st, i, j - 1, 1);
    } else if (t === 0 || t === 1 || t === 59) {
      if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) placeDye(st, i, j - 1, 0);
      else placeDye(st, i, j - 1, 1);
    } else if (st.inBounds(i, j - 2)
      && st.liquid[st.idx(i, j - 1)] === 255 && st.liquid[st.idx(i, j - 2)] === 255) {
      placeDye(st, i, j - 1, 5);
    }
  }
  // ---- 垂吊段（cs:71449-71466）：天花板上垂下的 style 7 ----
  if (activeAt(st, i, j + 1)) return;
  {
    // 无 clamp 扫描（cs:71453-71461），越界格视为非活性
    let found = false;
    for (let k = i - rad; k < i + rad && !found; k++) {
      for (let l = j - rad; l < j + rad && !found; l++) {
        if (activeAt(st, k, l) && sheetAt(st, k, l) === 227) found = true;
      }
    }
    if (found) return;
    if (sheetAt(st, i, j) === 0) placeDye(st, i, j + 1, 7);
  }
}

/** GrowGlowTulips（cs:45628）+ TryGrowingGlowTulip（cs:73171）+ NoNearbyGlowTulips（cs:73196）1:1 */
function growGlowTulips(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
  void gs;
  const w = st.w, h = st.h;
  const worldSize = w <= 4200 ? 0 : w <= 6400 ? 1 : 2;                 // GetWorldSize（cs:6518）
  const n2 = 100, n3 = 300;
  const target = worldSize === 1 ? 4 : worldSize === 2 ? 6 : 2;
  let placed = 0;
  let budget = 10000;
  while (placed < target) {
    budget--;
    if (budget <= 0) break;
    const pickLeft = placed >= ((target / 2) | 0) && (budget <= 7500 || rng.int(0, 1) !== 0);
    const i = pickLeft ? rng.int(w - n3, w - n2 - 1) : rng.int(n2, n3 - 1);
    const j = rng.int(gs.worldSurface, h - 201);                        // Next(ws, h-200)
    if (tryGrowGlowTulip(st, rng, i, j)) placed++;
  }
}

/** HasValidGroundForGlowTulipBelowSpot（cs:73148）1:1 */
function glowTulipGround(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (!inWorld(st, x, y, 2)) return false;
  if (!activeAt(st, x, y + 1)) return false;
  const t = sheetAt(st, x, y + 1);
  const okType = t === 0 || t === 70 || t === 633 || t === 59 || t === 225
    || CONV_GRASS.has(t) || t === 1 || t === 25 || t === 117 || t === 203 || TILE_MOSS.has(t);
  if (!okType) return false;
  return solidAllowBottomSlope(st, x, y + 1);
}

function tryGrowGlowTulip(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, i: number, j: number): boolean {
  const w = st.w, h = st.h;
  for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
    const x = rng.int(Math.max(10, i - 10), Math.min(w - 10, i + 10) - 1);
    const y = rng.int(Math.max(10, j - 10), Math.min(h - 10, j + 10) - 1);
    if (!glowTulipGround(st, x, y)) continue;
    // NoNearbyGlowTulips（cs:73196）：±120 方框内无 656
    let near = false;
    const x0 = Math.max(10, Math.min(w - 11, x - 120));
    const x1 = Math.max(10, Math.min(w - 11, x + 120));
    const y0 = Math.max(10, Math.min(h - 11, y - 120));
    const y1 = Math.max(10, Math.min(h - 11, y + 120));
    for (let a = x0; a <= x1 && !near; a++) {
      for (let b = y0; b <= y1 && !near; b++) {
        if (activeAt(st, a, b) && sheetAt(st, a, b) === 656) near = true;
      }
    }
    if (near) continue;
    // PlaceTile(x, y, 656)（cs:59519）：(!active || tileCut || Breakable) && 地面有效
    const k0 = st.idx(x, y);
    const cutOk = !st.flags[k0] || TILE_CUT.has(SHEET[st.type[k0]]);
    if (!cutOk) continue;
    st.setTileSilent(x, y, GLOW_TULIP, 0, 0);
    st.half[k0] = 0;
    st.slope[k0] = 0;
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/** PlaceChilletEggs（cs:45659）+ TryPlacingChilletEgg（cs:45709）1:1（Place2x2 锚=右下角） */
function placeChilletEggs(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
  const w = st.w, h = st.h;
  const worldSize = w <= 4200 ? 0 : w <= 6400 ? 1 : 2;
  const target = worldSize === 1 ? 9 : worldSize === 2 ? 12 : 6;
  let placed = 0;
  let budget = 10000;
  while (placed < target) {
    budget--;
    if (budget <= 0) break;
    const i = rng.int(100, w - 101);
    const j = rng.int(Math.floor(gs.rockLevel), h - 201);               // Next(rockLayer, h-200)
    if (tryPlaceChilletEgg(st, rng, i, j)) placed++;
  }
}

/** chillet 蛋地面门 = glow tulip 同款（cs:45734 与 73148 逐字一致） */
const chilletGround = glowTulipGround;

function tryPlaceChilletEgg(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, i: number, j: number): boolean {
  const w = st.w, h = st.h;
  for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
    const x = rng.int(Math.max(10, i - 10), Math.min(w - 10, i + 10) - 1);
    const y = rng.int(Math.max(10, j - 10), Math.min(h - 10, j + 10) - 1);
    if (!chilletGround(st, x, y)) continue;
    // NoNearbyChilletEggs（cs:45689）：±20 方框内无 752

    const y0 = Math.max(10, Math.min(h - 11, y - 20));
    const y1 = Math.max(10, Math.min(h - 11, y + 20));
    for (let a = x0; a <= x1 && !near; a++) {

      }
    }
    if (near) continue;
    // PlaceTile(x, y, 752) → Place2x2（cs:51352）：2×2 净空 + 双列地面 SolidTile2
    if (x < 5 || x > w - 5 || y < 5 || y > h - 5) continue;
    let ok = true;
    for (let a = x - 1; a <= x && ok; a++) {

      }

/** DyePlants pass（cs:20126）：w 次 plantDye + 熟成 + 荧光郁金香 + 啮龙蛋 */
export function runDyePlantsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
  for (let i = 0; i < st.w; i++) {
    plantDye(st, rng, gs, rng.int(100, st.w - 101), rng.int(100, st.h - 201));
  }
  matureHerbPlants(st, rng, gs);                                        // cs:20135（原版在此 pass 内调用）
  growGlowTulips(st, rng, gs);

}

/** Collision.CanHitLine（Collision.cs:590）1:1：Tile 级视线（3 格宽扫掠） */
function canHitLine(st: TileStore, x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number): boolean {
  let num = Math.max(1, Math.min(st.w - 1, x1));                        // 越界钳制（cs:596-627）
  let num2 = Math.max(1, Math.min(st.h - 40, y1));
  const num3 = Math.max(1, Math.min(st.w - 1, x2));
  const num4 = Math.max(1, Math.min(st.h - 40, y2));
  const n5 = Math.abs(num - num3);
  const n6 = Math.abs(num2 - num4);
  if (n5 === 0 && n6 === 0) return true;
  let n7 = 1, n8 = 1;
  if (n5 === 0 || n6 === 0) {
    if (n5 === 0) n7 = 0;
    if (n6 === 0) n8 = 0;
  } else if (n5 > n6) {
    n7 = n5 / n6;
  } else {
    n8 = n6 / n5;
  }
  let f1 = 0, f2 = 0;
  let mode: 1 | 2 = num2 < num4 ? 2 : 1;
  let rx = (n5 | 0), ry = (n6 | 0);
  const sx = Math.sign(num3 - num);
  const sy = Math.sign(num4 - num2);
  let done = false, done2 = false;
  // 3 格宽 swath 任一实心非顶面格 → false（越界 = null → 直接 miss）
  const blocked = (cx: number, cy: number): boolean =>
    !st.inBounds(cx - 1, cy) || !st.inBounds(cx, cy) || !st.inBounds(cx + 1, cy)
    || solidTile(st, cx - 1, cy) || solidTile(st, cx, cy) || solidTile(st, cx + 1, cy);
  do {
    if (mode === 2) {
      f1 += n7;
      const step = f1 | 0;
      f1 -= step;
      for (let s = 0; s < step; s++) {
        if (blocked(num, num2)) return false;
        if (rx === 0 && ry === 0) { done = true; break; }
        num += sx; rx--;
        if (rx === 0 && ry === 0 && step === 1) done2 = true;
      }
      if (ry !== 0) mode = 1;
    } else {
      f2 += n8;
      const step = f2 | 0;
      f2 -= step;
      for (let s = 0; s < step; s++) {
        if (blocked(num, num2)) return false;
        if (rx === 0 && ry === 0) { done = true; break; }
        num2 += sy; ry--;
        if (rx === 0 && ry === 0 && step === 1) done2 = true;
      }
      if (rx !== 0) mode = 2;
    }
    if (solidTile(st, num, num2)) return false;                          // 中心格复检（cs:763-771）
  } while (!(done || done2));
  return true;
}

      if (!IS_VINE.has(s)) continue;

		TileFrame(i + 1, j);
		TileFrame(i + 1, j + 1);

    if (c.w[i]! !== st.wall[i]!) { r.dW++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`W(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.w[i]} j${st.wall[i]}`); }
    if (c.l[i]! !== st.liquid[i]!) { r.dL++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`L(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.l[i]} j${st.liquid[i]}`); }
    if (c.hf[i]! !== st.half[i]!) { r.dHf++; mark(i); const k = `H${c.hf[i]}>${st.half[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`H(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.hf[i]} j${st.half[i]}`); }
    if (c.sl[i]! !== st.slope[i]!) { r.dSl++; mark(i); const k = `S${c.sl[i]}>${st.slope[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`S(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.sl[i]} j${st.slope[i]}`); }
    const vl = c.l[i]! > 0 ? c.lt[i]! + 1 : 0;
    const jl = st.liquid[i]! > 0 ? st.liquidType[i]! : 0;
    if (vl !== jl) { r.dLt++; mark(i); const k = `Y${vl}>${jl}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`Y(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${vl} j${jl} liq${c.l[i]}`); }
    const via = c.ia[i]! ? 1 : 0;
    const jia = (st.wire[i]! >>> 5) & 1;
    if (via !== jia) { r.dIa++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`I(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${via} j${jia}`); }
  }
  if (firstI >= 0) r.first = `(${firstI % W},${Math.floor(firstI / W)})`;
  r.pairs = [...pair.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, Number(process.env.SW_WWW_PAIRS ?? 8)).map(([k, n]) => [k, n] as [string, number]);
  return r;
}
const isClean = (r: Row) => !(r.dA || r.dT || r.dW || r.dL || r.dHf || r.dSl || r.dLt || r.dIa);
function printRow(r: Row): void {
  const bad = !isClean(r);
  console.log(`${String(r.idx).padStart(3)} ${DUMPNAME.get(r.idx)} ← ${r.tag.padEnd(28)} ` +
    `A=${String(r.dA).padStart(6)} T=${String(r.dT).padStart(6)} W=${String(r.dW).padStart(5)} L=${String(r.dL).padStart(5)} ` +
    `Hf=${String(r.dHf).padStart(5)} Sl=${String(r.dSl).padStart(5)} Lt=${String(r.dLt).padStart(4)} Ia=${String(r.dIa).padStart(4)} ${bad ? '✗ ' + r.first : '✓'}`);
  if (bad) {
    console.log(`     pairs: ${r.pairs.map(([k, n]) => `${k}×${n}`).join(' ')}`);
    console.log(`     samples: ${r.samples.join(' | ')}`);
  }
}

// ---- 槽位计划 ----
type Chests = Array<{ x: number; y: number; items: Array<{ id: number; stack: number } | null> }>;
interface Step {
  dump?: number;                       // 对拍 golden 槽
  base: number;                        // 输入基座 golden 槽
  run: (st: TileStore, gs: GenState, rng: RNG, chests: Chests, world: World) => void | Promise<void>;
}
interface SlotPlan { entry: string; steps: Step[] }

/** 跨槽生产者重算：shrineSpots / oceanTreasures（golden47/36 干净基座 + m_ 中途边界） */
function computeProducers(): { shrineSpots: Array<{ x: number; y: number }>; oceanTreasures: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> } {
  const mj = boundary('m_JungleShrines');
  const { st: stJ } = buildHybrid(47, mj);
  restoreGenSolid(mj.gensolid);
  const shrineSpots = runJungleShrinePass(stJ, new RNG(SEED), structuredClone(mj.gs) as GenState);
  const mo = boundary('m_OceanCaves');
  const { st: stO } = buildHybrid(36, mo);
  restoreGenSolid(mo.gensolid);
  const oceanTreasures = runOceanCavesPass(stO, new RNG(SEED), structuredClone(mo.gs) as GenState);
  return { shrineSpots, oceanTreasures };
}

async function runSettleStep(st: TileStore, gs: GenState, rng: RNG, world: World): Promise<void> {
  world.store = st;
  world.shimmerX = gs.shimmerX; world.shimmerY = gs.shimmerY;
  world.genWaterLine = gs.waterLine;
  if ((gs.dungeonSide as number) === 0) world.genDungeonExempt = null;
  else {
    const edge = Math.floor(world.w * 0.05), mid = Math.floor(world.w * 0.55);
    world.genDungeonExempt = gs.dungeonSide < 0
      ? { x0: edge, x1: Math.floor(world.w * 0.45), y0: Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) + 10, y1: (world.h - 200) - 10 }
      : { x0: mid, x1: world.w - edge, y0: Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) + 10, y1: (world.h - 200) - 10 };
  }
  await settleWorldLiquids(world, 'gen', undefined, rng);
  flipGenSolid([484], false);
}

  netSuppress = false;

  constructor(w: number, h: number, bufs?: import('../workers/protocol').TileBuffers) {
    this.w = w; this.h = h;
    // buffers 注入（worker transfer 重建路径）：直接以移交的 ArrayBuffer 包装 TypedArray，
    // 跳过分配与拷贝。缺省 explored 由调用方（World.fromPacket）补齐
    if (bufs) {
      this.type = new Uint16Array(bufs.type);
      this.flags = new Uint8Array(bufs.flags);
      this.frameX = new Uint16Array(bufs.frameX);
      this.frameY = new Uint16Array(bufs.frameY);
      this.wall = new Uint16Array(bufs.wall);
      this.liquid = new Uint8Array(bufs.liquid);
      this.liquidType = new Uint8Array(bufs.liquidType);
      this.half = new Uint8Array(bufs.half);
      this.slope = new Uint8Array(bufs.slope);
      this.wire = new Uint8Array(bufs.wire);

      // fromPacket 路径已按 explored 同款兜底补零，此处理论上不会缺，防御性兜底）
      const nBuf = bufs.type.byteLength / 2;
      this.paint = bufs.paint ? new Uint8Array(bufs.paint) : new Uint8Array(nBuf);
      this.paintWall = bufs.paintWall ? new Uint8Array(bufs.paintWall) : new Uint8Array(nBuf);
      return;
    }
    const n = w * h;
    this.type = new Uint16Array(n);
    this.flags = new Uint8Array(n);
    this.frameX = new Uint16Array(n);
   *  只有光照订阅（水的光衰减）——避免水流时每帧冲爆 chunk 重建队列造成卡顿 */

  onLiquidChanged(fn: (x: number, y: number) => void) {
    this.liquidListeners.push(fn);
  }

  /** 唯一的写入入口（生成/导入期可绕过用 setTileSilent） */
  setTile(x: number, y: number, type: number, frameX = 0, frameY = 0) {
    if (!this.inBounds(x, y)) return;
    const i = this.idx(x, y);
    const wasActive = this.flags[i] !== 0;
    this.type[i] = type;
    this.flags[i] = type !== 0 ? 1 : 0;
    this.frameX[i] = frameX;
    this.frameY[i] = frameY;
    if (type === 0) { this.half[i] = 0; this.slope[i] = 0; } // 挖除清半砖/坡面
    // 油漆随方块清除/铺块重置：

    //   PlaceTile（WorldGen.cs:59499-59501）!active() 时 Clear(Tile|TilePaint|Slope)。
    //   即油漆只在 active→active 的替换（草化/转化）中存活
    if (type === 0 || !wasActive) this.paint[i] = 0;
    if (this.netReporter && !this.netSuppress) this.netReporter({ a: TileOpAction.SetTile, x, y, v: type, fx: frameX, fy: frameY });
    this.listeners.forEach((fn) => fn(x, y));
  }

  /** 运行期改半砖/坡面位（锤子交互用；生成期直接写数组即可） */

	private static bool HasValidGroundForGlowTulipBelowSpot(int x, int y)
	{
		if (!InWorld(x, y, 2))
		{
			return false;
		}
		Tile tile = Main.tile[x, y + 1];
		if (tile == null || !tile.active())
		{
			return false;
		}
		ushort type = tile.type;
		if (type < 0 || type >= TileID.Count)
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (type != 0 && type != 70 && type != 633 && type != 59 && type != 225 && !TileID.Sets.Conversion.Grass[type] && !TileID.Sets.Conversion.Stone[type] && !Main.tileMoss[type])
		{
			return false;
		}
		return SolidTileAllowBottomSlope(x, y + 1);
	}

	private static bool TryGrowingGlowTulip(int i, int j)
	{
		int num = 5;
		for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
		{
			int num2 = genRand.Next(Math.Max(10, i - 10), Math.Min(Main.maxTilesX - 10, i + 10));
			int num3 = genRand.Next(Math.Max(10, j - 10), Math.Min(Main.maxTilesY - 10, j + 10));

				continue;

			PlaceTile(num2, num3, 656, mute: true);
			Tile tile = Main.tile[num2, num3];

				if (!generatingWorld && Main.netMode == 2 && Main.tile[num2, num3] != null && Main.tile[num2, num3].active())
				{
					NetMessage.SendTileSquare(-1, num2, num3);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static bool NoNearbyGlowTulips(int i, int j)
	{
		int num = Utils.Clamp(i - 120, 10, Main.maxTilesX - 1 - 10);
		int num2 = Utils.Clamp(i + 120, 10, Main.maxTilesX - 1 - 10);

	public static void CheckStalactiteEcho(int x, int j)
	{
		Tile tile = Main.tile[x, j];
		ushort type = tile.type;
		int num = ((type != 694) ? 1 : 2);
		bool num2 = tile.frameY < num * 18;
		int style = tile.frameX / 18;
		int num3 = j - tile.frameY % (num * 18) / 18;
		int num4 = ((!num2) ? (18 * num) : 0);
		int j2 = (num2 ? (num3 - 1) : (num3 + num));
		bool flag = (num2 ? (!SolidTileAllowTopSlope(x, j2)) : (!SolidTileAllowBottomSlope(x, j2)));
		if (!flag)
		{
			int num5 = num3;
			int num6 = 0;
			while (num5 < num3 + num)
			{
				Tile tile2 = Main.tile[x, num5];
				if (tile2.type != type || tile2.frameX != tile.frameX || tile2.frameY != num4 + num6)
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
				num5++;
				num6 += 18;
			}
		}
		if (!flag)
		{
			return;
		}
		destroyObject = true;
		for (int i = num3; i < num3 + num; i++)
		{
			if (Main.tile[x, i].type == type)
			{
				KillTile(x, i);
			}
		}
		destroyObject = false;
		int stalactiteEchoDrop = GetStalactiteEchoDrop(x, j, style);
		if (stalactiteEchoDrop != 0)
		{
			Item.NewItem(GetItemSource_FromTileBreak(x, j), x * 16, j * 16, 16, 32, stalactiteEchoDrop);
		}
	}

 "new_string": "/** TileFrame 生成期树域+堆域子集（cs:82067 边界；TileFrameCosmetic 生成期跳过；\n *  PlantCheck(3/73 on 草)恒 no-op）。宝石树 583-589/灰烬树 634 在地下/地狱，花圃\n *  扫描窗（地表 ±30）不可达；棕榈 323 只长在沙族上、花圃击杀门要求下方草 2，恒\n *  不触发——均不派发（CheckPalmTree 在本域亦恒 no-op）。\n *  ★RRRRR 2026-08-20：①非活性格补 TileFrame 头清（cs:82078-82082 half/slope/块漆）；\n *  ②补 Check3x2 186/187 堆级联（#90 根因：花圃杀堆底格→帧结构破→整堆 KillTile，\n *  golden 187→dead×51 真身）；185 CheckPile 级联暂不派发（本种子仅 1 格\n *  185→dead，备案观察）。 */\nfunction frameCellTree(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {\n  if (x <= 5 || y <= 5 || x >= st.w - 5 || y >= st.h - 5) return;   // cs:82069 边界\n  const k = st.idx(x, y);\n  if (!st.flags[k]) {                                                // cs:82078 inactive 头清\n    st.half[k] = 0; st.slope[k] = 0; st.paint[k] = 0;\n    return;\n  }\n  const s = SHEET[st.type[k]];\n  if (s === 5) checkTreeAt(st, rng, x, y, false);\n  else if (s === 596 || s === 616) checkTreeAt(st, rng, x, y, true);\n  else if (s === 186 || s === 187) check3x2PileSweep(st, rng, x, y, s);\n}\n\n/** Check3x2 的 186/187 支（cs:49190-49346 结构/底材复核 + cs:49348-49364 草底\n *  降帧支 + cs:49385-49399 击杀段）。帧结构推堆原点：top=y-(frameY%36)/18、\n *  left=x-(frameX/18)%3、样式列 num6=⌊frameX/18/3⌋；六格任一缺格/错帧 → flag；\n *  三列底 SolidTileAllowBottomSlope+巨石排除+按样式列材质门；flag → 六格同型\n *  KillTile（destroyObject 语义=级联内不再入本函数）。 */\nlet pile3x2Destroying = false;\nfunction check3x2PileSweep(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number, sheet: number): void {\n  if (pile3x2Destroying) return;                                     // cs:49194 destroyObject\n  const k0 = st.idx(x, y);\n  const num3 = (st.frameY[k0] / 36) | 0;\n  const num4 = st.frameY[k0] % 36;\n  const top = y - ((num4 / 18) | 0);\n  let num5 = (st.frameX[k0] / 18) | 0;\n  let num6 = 0;\n  while (num5 > 2) { num5 -= 3; num6++; }\n  num5 = x - num5;\n  const num7 = num6 * 54;\n  const num8 = top + 2;\n  let flag = false;\n  for (let k = num5; k < num5 + 3; k++) {\n    for (let l = top; l < num8; l++) {\n      // 六格结构复核（vanilla null→new Tile=非活性→flag）\n      if (!st.inBounds(k, l)) { flag = true; continue; }\n      const kk = st.idx(k, l);\n      if (!st.flags[kk] || SHEET[st.type[kk]] !== sheet\n        || st.frameX[kk] !== (k - num5) * 18 + num7 || st.frameY[kk] !== (l - top) * 18 + num3 * 36) flag = true;\n    }\n    if (!st.inBounds(k, num8)) { flag = true; continue; }             // 原版 null tile → 不支撑\n    const bi = st.idx(k, num8);\n    if (!solidAllowBottomSlope(st, k, num8)) { flag = true; continue; }          // cs:49325/49282\n    if (st.flags[bi] && BOULDERS.has(SHEET[st.type[bi]])) { flag = true; continue; }  // InvalidTileForPiles\n    if (!st.flags[bi]) continue;                                      // cs:49329/49290 非活性底免材质门\n    const b = SHEET[st.type[bi]];\n    if (sheet === 187) {                                              // cs:49331-49346 材质按样式列\n      const ok = num6 <= 5 ? (b === 59 || b === 60 || b === 226)          // Mud∪丛林草/砖\n        : num6 <= 8 ? (b === 57 || b === 58 || b === 75 || b === 76)      // 骨/灰烬族\n          : num6 >= 29 ? SAND_FAM_3X2.has(b)                              // 沙族（29-34）\n            : true;\n      if (!ok) flag = true;\n    } else {                                                          // 186（cs:49291-49323）\n      const ok = num6 >= 26 && num6 <= 31 ? (b === 147 || ICE_SET.has(b) || b === 162 || b === 224)\n        : num6 >= 32 ? (b === 59 || b === 70)\n          : true;\n      if (!ok) flag = true;\n    }\n  }\n  // 187→186 草底降帧支（cs:49348-49364）：顶行帧 756-900 且三底列全非草族\n  if (sheet === 187 && st.inBounds(num5, top) && st.inBounds(num5 + 2, top + 2)) {\n    const kTop = st.idx(num5, top);\n    if (st.frameX[kTop] >= 756 && st.frameX[kTop] <= 900) {\n      const grassy = (k: number): boolean => {\n        if (!st.flags[k]) return false;\n        const s = SHEET[st.type[k]];\n        return s === 2 || s === 477 || s === 492;\n      };\n      if (!grassy(st.idx(num5, top + 2)) && !grassy(st.idx(num5 + 1, top + 2)) && !grassy(st.idx(num5 + 2, top + 2))) {\n        for (let m = num5; m < num5 + 3; m++) {\n          for (let l = top; l < top + 2; l++) {\n            const kk = st.idx(m, l);\n            st.frameX[kk] = st.frameX[kk]! - 378;\n            st.type[kk] = PILE_LARGE;                                 // → 186\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  if (!flag) return;\n  pile3x2Destroying = true;                                           // cs:49386 destroyObject=true\n  for (let m = num5; m < num5 + 3; m++) {\n    for (let l = top; l < num8; l++) {\n      if (!st.inBounds(m, l)) continue;\n      const kk = st.idx(m, l);\n      if (st.flags[kk] && SHEET[st.type[kk]] === sheet) {\n        st.setTileSilent(m, l, 0);                                    // KillTile 生成期子集\n        squareFrameTree(st, rng, m, l);                               // cs:63967 尾扫（树级联仍可达）\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  pile3x2Destroying = false;\n}\n\n/** SquareTileFrame（cs:80926-80934）列优先 3×3 调用序 */\nfunction squareFrameTree(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {\n  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {\n    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) frameCellTree(st, rng, x + dx, y + dy);\n  }\n}\n\n/** KillTile + 尾部 SquareTileFrame（cs:63559 的生成期有效子集）——树/堆坍塌入口 */\nexport function killTileTree(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {\n  if (!activeAt(st, x, y)) return;\n  st.setTileSilent(x, y, 0);\n  squareFrameTree(st, rng, x, y);\n}"
